title: Rooftop rain catchment first-flush upgrade
summary: Separates the dirtiest first roof runoff and records roof risk before rainwater storage.
content: Rooftop rain catchment first-flush upgrade is a practical offline routine for rainwater collection. Inspect roof material, bird droppings, ash, dust, dead animals, chemicals, gutters, and nearby smoke before collecting. Discard or separate the first dirty runoff after dry periods. Screen leaves and insects before storage and cover containers against mosquitoes. Label rainwater as untreated unless proper safe-water steps and official guidance allow use. Stop collection after wildfire ash, chemical dust, industrial fallout, or unknown contamination.
